title: AuditEvent
description: Append-only audit record (CONTRACT_SKETCH §5). details never contains tokens, codes, prompt/answer text or file contents. Known actions (v1): auth.logout, auth.denied, pairing.create, pairing.redeem, members.update, node.enrollment_create, node.enroll, node.revoke, node.token_rotate, task.submit, task.answer, task.cancel, task.retry, command.expire, artifact.reject, artifact.download_ticket, artifact.download. New actions may be added in a minor revision.

target.description: Id of the affected object (rt_, cmd_, art_, node_, usr_, ws_, pair_, enr_).

request_id.description: null for actions performed by background jobs (actor=system).
